name: ac-materia
description: Multi-page website for an artisan workshop association, built with HTML, Sass and JavaScript. Uses ITCSS, BEM, Bootstrap and modern CSS features such as cascade layers, container queries and OKLCH, with responsive images, Flexbox/Grid layouts and production asset optimization.

paragraphs: This project is a desktop-first, multi-page website for the artisan workshops organized by the Asociación Cultural Materia. Built as a front-end showcase of modern CSS, it uses cascade layers, container queries, oklch colors, Flex/Grid layouts and responsive image techniques.

Developed using version 3.x of UOC Boilerplate as the starter template: a modern frontend development base that includes Parcel, a Sass compiler, an ES6 transpiler, minifiers, an image transformer, and development tools. Created by Jordi Tarrida (jorditarrida@uoc.edu).
features: The project incorporates modern CSS functionality and advanced layout techniques to improve scalability, performance, and design adaptability.
@layer → CSS layering system that allows explicit control over style priority.
@supports → detects support for CSS properties before applying them.
@container → styles based on the container's size rather than the viewport.
:is(), :where(), :has() → refined selectors and advanced conditional logic in CSS.
